verdicts.reason: A keeps the can-in-circle illustration intact and has no collisions, but the hierarchy is wrong. The two badges are oversized, stacked pills that outweigh the headline, the body copy is tiny and wedged beside GLACIER, and the headline sits below its own supporting copy. B gives the headline clear dominance and keeps the CTA and badges together in one row. However, it pulls the can off its circle, which breaks the illustration, and puts the body copy on top of the circle, jammed against the left edge with no margin. GLACIER also drops below the headline, and the CTA and badges are small and cramped.
